admitted.nl: Copy the top three rows into the bottom three rows in reverse order, leaving all other rows unchanged.
Vertically mirror the first contiguous nonzero block against the bottom edge.
Reflect the first three rows vertically, but only when the grid has exactly three columns.
Complete vertical symmetry by copying each nonzero cell from the top three rows to its reflected position at the bottom.
Copy rows 0, 1, and 2 to rows 9, 8, and 7 respectively, only for a 10-row grid.
Duplicate the top three-row colored pattern at the bottom in reverse order, but do nothing on grids with fewer than ten rows.
Make the grid vertically symmetric using its first three rows as the template, preserving the middle rows.
For a 10x3 grid, replace the last three rows with the reversed sequence of the first three rows.
Reflect the non-background pattern from the top edge to the bottom edge, assuming zero is background.

rejected.nl: Append a reversed copy of the first three rows into the final three row positions, without changing any other cells.
